UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Travelling across the globe, Martin meets a rat-catcher and a singing dingo, and reveals how dogs are genetically similar to wolves. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Martin Clunes: A Man and His Dogs
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Martin explores how dogs' abilities have been harnessed to good effect in pursuits ranging from tracking and herding to assisting the police and people with disabilities. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Martin Clunes: Islands of Australia
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: The actor explores Mundoo Island, which has provided a way of life for five generations of one farming family, and also investigates Phillip Island. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: David Jason's Great British Inventions
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: David Jason examines British innovations in the history of engineering, beginning with a look at wheeled vehicles like the Penny Farthing and Stephenson's rocket. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Oman to the Maldives: Simon journeys from Oman to the Maldives, where the tropical coral islands are being damaged by bleaching and an entire island has been manufactured as a landfill dump. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Indian Ocean with Simon Reeve
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Sri Lanka to Bangladesh: Simon finds out about battles in Sri Lanka, then moves on to Bangladesh, where he hears about the fast-growing industry providing prawns for the West. S1 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Shardlow to Stoke-on-Trent: Robbie Cumming journeys from Shardlow to Etruria Junction, Stoke on Trent, exploring the Trent and Mersey Canal. S1 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Froghall to Bugsworth Basin: Robbie Cumming explores the English canal network. A low canal tunnel in Staffordshire proves to be problematic and Robbie helps out a stranded boater. S1 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Marple to Huddersfield: Robbie Cumming continues across the Pennines from Marple to Huddersfield, where his journey is hampered by a fallen tree and a leaking lock pound. S1 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Sowerby Bridge to Manchester: Robbie Cumming travels along the Rochdale Canal from Sowerby Bridge to Manchester, but disaster strikes when he runs aground. S1 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Winsford to Weston Point: With the Anderton Boat Lift out of action, Robbie explores the scenic River Weaver onboard a borrowed narrowboat called 'Tench'. S7 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Canal Boat Diaries
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Runcorn to Middlewich: Robbie sets off from Runcorn on the Bridgewater Canal, but a series of unfortunate mishaps soon tests his patience - from lost camera footage to closed canals. S7 Ep5

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Dream Car Fixers
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Porsche: Sheldon and Peter have their work cut out as they try to source and restore a Porsche 944 for retired newsagent Ozzie. S2 Ep6

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: New: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Morris Minor/Riley Special: The guys snap up a 1958 Morris Minor 1000, followed by a 1930s Riley Special - but soon learn it's definitely not special and probably not even a Riley. S9 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: AC Cobra/Volvo F8T8: The team have a record number of cars to auction, but Derek finds room for one more - a replica AC Cobra. A couple are reunited with their Volvo breakdown truck. S1 Ep8

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: E Type S2/Escort RS Turbo: A classic car fan with a love of the Jaguar E-Type reluctantly sends his dream car to auction, hoping to buy a motorhome. Two Ford Escorts get Dave's pulse racing. S1 Ep9

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Fiat Strada Abarth/Austin 10: Dave finds two rare Fiats and a VW Corrado. Derek tries to remove an old Morris that appears to be supporting the garage roof. What could go wrong? S6 Ep3

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Bangers & Cash
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Ford Granada/Toyota Hilux: Derek navigates the dry stone walls of the Peak District to collect a very original 1988 Opel Manta. Plus, Dave deals with a Ford Granada rally support vehicle. S6 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great British Railway Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Dundee to Aberdeen: Michael Portillo travels from Dundee to Aberdeen, stopping off at Glamis Castle, where the Queen Mother grew up, and making an excursion into the Eastern Highlands. S11 Ep4

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great British Railway Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Biggin Hill to Ashdown Forest: Michael Portillo takes a trip in a Second World War Spitfire above Biggin Hill aerodrome. S13 Ep1

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.title: Great British Railway Journeys
UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Hassocks To Benenden: Michael Portillo arrives in Hassocks and the beautiful Sussex village of Ditchling, before making his way to the village of Benenden. S13 Ep2

UAndYesterdayPlus1.uk.description: Elan / BMW: The team take on one of their most ambitious projects to date - a 1963 Lotus Elan Series 1. Their second project could also amaze... by showing a profit... a 90's BMW 3 series. S5 Ep6
